verdict.rationale: Gemini API docs show core building blocks for generating insights from data — multimodal analysis (text/image/video), embeddings for semantic search/clustering, structured output, and function calling to act on real data — which are the raw capabilities an AI-native product would use to surface insights from user data. However, as a developer API rather than an end-user product, there's no evidence of a first-party or independent example showing insights actually surfaced 'inside a product' from a user's own data. Missing for 10: an end-to-end example/case study of surfacing personalized insights from a user's data within a product UI, and independent corroboration beyond vendor docs.
